You made money but you didn't earn goodwill I don't think you will be recommended by me to anyone to waste their hard earned money on you. featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you so much for appreciating our work.

Dear ma'am

Regarding the issue As I mentioned before starting the work, any cracks or leaks coming from outside in the building is not into our hands. Water damage inside cannot occur due to the plaster it only happens when the exterior area is compromised. ( which clearly  means no matter howmuch times you improve interior if your exterior is not good things will worsen and it was already communicated to you before.

If there are cracks in the terrace
Or outside the building , you will need to fill those cracks with a waterproof seal and waterproof the entire terrace and Building exterior broken areas need to be  plastered. I provided a quotation for the terrace waterproofing work before we began the interior work, But your society is not ready to do this work.

Please understand this.
The building is old ( decades old) , and day by day, the plaster is damaged and form new cracks from the exterior of building , leading to new cracks forming on the outside.
We repaired the interior of the flat, but to stop the leakage, you need to fix it from the exterior. I am a building maintenance contractor also, and I also work with consultants.
Thank You.
